units.source_text: 日文称汉字的左边为“偏”，右边为旁。

en.t: In Japanese, the left side of a kanji is called the hen, and the right side is called the tsukuri.

units.source_text: 只示旁而叫人猜偏的游戏称为“偏继”游戏。

en.t: A game in which only the right side is shown and people are made to guess the left side is called hen-tsugi.

units.source_text: 或者双方轮流给旁加上偏，加不出者为负。

en.t: Alternatively, the two sides take turns adding a left side to the right side, and the one who cannot add one loses.
